Developer Surface

Build around verified nodes first, then verified apps and games.

The current developer surface focuses on PHN contracts, node activation, staking, vesting, and exchange integrations. The future surface expands into Skymetric Chain, game contracts, and governance modules.

Core contracts

Token, identity registry, reward vault, sale, staking, vesting, fee router, and timelock governance modules.

CLI

Node operators start with the local CLI:

npm run phn-node -- init

SDK roadmap

JavaScript SDK, Android SDK, wallet widgets, validator APIs, and integration helpers for verified node apps.

Future chain modules

Skymetric Chain contracts are planned for SKY utility, bridges, native DEX routing, game economies, and SKYGOV proposals.

Future Developer Tracks

  • Chain: EVM-compatible Skymetric Chain testnet, explorer, validator tooling, and bridge modules.
  • Games: NodeRunner, Proof of Human, and DePIN Wars contracts with anti-bot identity hooks.
  • Utility: SKY token interfaces for gas, app fees, NFT minting, and game actions.
  • Governance: SKYGOV proposal, voting, delegation, and treasury execution contracts.
